t: Up to 4x better dust extraction than standard sandpaper. Bosch Particle Control ensures all the dust particles are sucked into vacuum or filter. Particles move straight through the M480 open sanding net instead of clogging the surface or polluting the air. Highly efficient and extremely long-lasting. Ideal for flat surfaces, to rough and prepare surfaces for painting and to prepare or finish drywall. Attach with hook and loop.
